# Montownia Smaków

## Restaurant
Montownia Smaków is a restaurant in Warsaw at Popularna 71, 02-473 Warszawa, Poland.

## Website
- Homepage: https://montowniasmakow.pl/
- Menu: https://montowniasmakow.pl/menu/

## Contact
- Phone: +48 883 199 177
- Email: biuro@montowniasmakow.pl

## Cuisine
Fusion cuisine, burgers, pasta, ramen, curry, ribs, salads, desserts and seasonal dishes.

## Lunch
Lunch is offered Monday to Friday, 11:00–16:00. The lunch set is 31 zł and includes soup and a main course. The daily dishes can change.
